act_title: The Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers (Recognition of Forest Rights) Act, 2006
title: Nodal agency.–The Ministry of the Central Government dealing with Tribal Affairs or any
text:
11. Nodal agency.–The Ministry of the Central Government dealing with Tribal Affairs or any

officer or authority authorised by the Central Government in this behalf shall be the nodal agency for the
implementation of the provisions of this Act.
